statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness that have persisted despite initial management for supraventricular tachycardia.
A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is indicated to further characterize the arrhythmia and correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances.
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the diagnosis I47.1 and R42.
The diagnosis codes are I47.1 and R42.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code PR-204.
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
